rows.parked_on: owner: transactions_r re-authorisation (OWNER_ACTION reauthorise_transactions_r) + data: no order yet
rows.note: commerce.orders_ingest (cfo, 6h cadence) reads the transactions_r gate from oauth_credentials.scopes + etsy.probe; closed -> UNMEASURED, zero network calls; open -> EtsyClient.get_shop_receipts pages receipts into cohorts.record_customer/record_order (Etsy user id only, no PII) and sale LedgerEntry rows, then enqueues commerce.order_readings. cohort_block computes cohorts.metrics per axis and validation-cohort lifetime contribution, which is the reward ceiling referral.check reads. Real gate: only the owner can grant the scope in a browser.

Customer and Order rows are written by the ingest on cadence (idempotent on etsy:<receipt>:<transaction>; 44 orders/43 customers from the fake feed, second run adds nothing; refused line recorded not fatal). With no orders the readings say UNMEASURED, never zero-as-measured.

order_readings.offer_results builds offers.Result per (design, offer) from Order.offer (set at ingest); handle_portfolio_review calls offers.may_retire for every RETIRE/REWORK/APPEAL_PROBLEM classification and, on refusal, replaces the discard intervention with the next untried offer and records it in review.actions and the portfolio.reviewed audit (offer_guard).

winner_block runs daily: Sku metrics from Listings+Orders, replication.is_winner on the top seller, a credible winner opens a bounded replication.study (operating_readings kind replication.study, capacity_share <= MAX_CAPACITY_SHARE); ideation.plan reads directives()['replication'] and constraints_text gives the study its capacity share of briefs as adjacent experiments (asserted 0 < n < all). UNMEASURED with no selling product.

Ingest calls cohorts.record_order which writes OrderVersion at sale time (buyer_trust.record_sale_version); pipeline.handle_certify calls buyer_trust.on_certified after a granted certificate: affected_orders/correction_notice over older versions (or same version, changed release hash), moves current_safe_version, stores the notice on each row (sent=False) and raises one OwnerAction correction_notice:<slug>@<version>; audits buyer_trust.correction_prepared. Sending stays owner-approved.

handle_portfolio_review builds SkuMetrics from ListingOutcome (impressions, visits->clicks, favourites), Order (orders, revenue, refunds) and published Listing.created_at (days_live); the ladder now diagnoses APPEAL_PROBLEM on real exposure instead of NO_EVIDENCE from empty inputs; exposure_read recorded in the audit.

reinvestment_block (daily via commerce.order_readings) sums trailing-30-day sale LedgerEntry rows and calls finance.reinvestment.recommend(db, gross_cad=...) (envelope from reserves + confidence ladder); a non-zero recommended_cad upserts an OwnerAction reinvestment:<YYYY-MM> with max_cost_cad = the recommendation. Zero confidence today -> honest CA$0 recommendation, no action.

standard.north_star_cohorts reads monthly cohorts from creative.tournament/expedition/grid_tournament audit rows, products, listings, incidents, listing outcomes and orders; north_star_from_db replaces north_star({}) both in /api/invention and in the daily creative.north_star handler. Metrics with no rows are absent (unmeasured), never zero.

creative.north_star (creative_director, daily) stores the reading per day and, when >=2 metrics regress cohort-on-cohort and regressions outnumber improvements, opens a P2 Incident creative.north_star_regression (non-halting), updates it while it persists, resolves it when it stops. LOWER_IS_BETTER handles creative_defect_rate direction.

rows.proof: tests/test_cert_orders.py::test_order_readings_drive_every_downstream_reader (ladder measured, value-ladder gap reaches ideation briefs); pricing guard path in handle_pricing_position
rows.note: ladder_block runs daily: ladder.shape over priced Listings placed on rungs, ladder.check_discount over PriceObservation sale history (measured against the reading's date), ladder.movement from buyers' first/later tiers, ladder.lifetime_value per customer (min cohort floor). Acted on: directives()['ladder_gaps'] becomes an ideation brief constraint; discount_refused makes handle_pricing_position append full-price-only.

bundle_items builds bundles.Item from certified products' concept facts (pod/form/occasion/weight/family) and bundles.candidates runs daily with no customers needed (autumn-oak + harvest-table pair found; incoherent pair excluded); handle_collection_assemble runs bundles.check on its members and refuses to assemble a set that fails pair affinity / spans departments (collection.bundle_check audit).

rows.parked_on: data: no promotion has run beside a full-price arm
rows.note: promotion_block runs daily: sale-window PriceObservation rows paired with Cohort organic/promoted arms through promotion.incrementality; do_not_repeat verdicts are read by handle_pricing_position (full price only). With no arms it records UNMEASURED and lists which promotions lack a full-price arm.

rows.parked_on: data: no orders yet (same order source gate as #11)
rows.note: repeat_block runs daily: repeat.windows (30/60/90/180) per first_product/first_category/first_season cohort from Order rows, lifetime contribution per buyer per cohort, repeat.recommend next projects; cohort lifetime contribution also feeds referral.check. UNMEASURED with no rows.

referral_block reads attributed customers (acquisition_source in REFERRAL_SOURCES) and their contribution from Order rows, reward spend from referral_reward LedgerEntry rows, gates measurability on runrate.orders_source_live; referral.check runs over referral.DECLARED mechanics against the measured lifetime contribution per buyer (may_run list). Also wired into runtime/commerce_readings.py replacing the hard-coded None inputs.

Order gained currency, amount_original, fx_usd_per_cad, fx_taken_on, fx_measured, fees_cad, offer, source (additive migration). pricing.decide_price now decides on net contribution: best measured contribution-per-visitor price point wins, MIN_NET_CONTRIBUTION_CAD floor is binding within the band; handle_pricing_position feeds it foreign_share and the last measured settlement rate from Order rows plus this product's PriceObservation points via release._pricing_net_inputs.

loop_block runs daily: loops.seed, then loops.observe per loop with the delta between recorded visits/orders (ListingOutcome visits, Order acquisition_source via SOURCE_TO_LOOP) and the row, so strength moves at runtime; GrowthLoop.contribution_cad column and Loop.confidence property added and surfaced in to_dict/evidence_summary.

scale.trajectory (orchestrator, nightly cadence): trajectory.observed_terms reads runrate.observe + releases/listings into observed Values, ASSUMED terms carry their basis, run() produces assumption_space (no probability) below the observed-share floor or a forecast above it, primary constraint from the observed funnel; stored per day in operating_readings and a changed binding constraint enqueues ops.capacity. /api/trajectory passes the real db and returns last_nightly.
